svg.title: AI-Powered Terraform Drift Detection & Remediation Platform
svg.desc: Flagship project, level1-v1.0.0 released, Level 2 in progress. Finds out when Azure no longer matches Terraform, explains who changed what, when, and what it costs, and raises it before it becomes an incident. Flow: Azure live state, scheduled plan in GitHub Actions with OIDC, deterministic Python drift engine, then a GitHub Issue per drifted resource, Activity Log attribution, LangGraph analysis (LLM opt-in) and Infracost with unmanaged resources, into a local dashboard. 2,885 tests passing, 98.85% drift-engine coverage, 135 end-to-end cases with failure injection, 6 required checks on main. OIDC trust limited to main with no client secrets, actions pinned by commit SHA, TFLint, Trivy and TruffleHog in CI, human-in-the-loop remediation. A live Azure test flagged 5 resources created outside Terraform, about $44.85 a month.
